_note: Run paths (Yusuf, 2026-10-27, plan https://claude.ai/artifact/6v3b5DfbBM3B4xwYJvj3Cu): four ways to specialise a run, each tiers deep (RunState.paths: path -> tier held). A founding tradition's path (path in data/traditions.json) starts at tier 1; each age-up brings a charter (RunState.charters_due), a pick of charter_choices paths' next tier at the next build phase (RunState.charter_offer, choose_charter). Slice 1 has tier I only, so a charter adds a path the town doesn't hold yet. Each tier: text (what it does, for the card), effects (summed with relics' and traditions' in RunState.mod(), same keys), dawn_card (a townsfolk role, or hero, always among the dawn cards when the pool has one: People.offer_picks). A path's buildings come up path_card_weight times as often in the blueprint draft (data/balance.json), like a tradition's. Effect keys only paths use so far: warrior_food_saving (share of each warrior's food the town saves), patrol_ease (warriors count this many more toward patrol pairs and squads), caravan_early (the southern caravan comes without its building), path_band_ease (every leaning bands this many sooner, not on top of a tradition's own ease).

heroes.name: Heroes
heroes.text: A town that lives by its champions.

tiers.text: A hero card at every dawn once heroes have somewhere to sleep. Training yards, kennels, duelling rings and trophy halls come up twice as often.

warband.name: Warband
warband.text: A town that holds its edge with spears.

tiers.text: A warrior card at every dawn. Warriors eat half as much, and they patrol in pairs and squads one warrior sooner.

guilds.name: Guilds
guilds.text: A town that grows by its hands.

tiers.text: One more dawn card, always a tribesperson among them. Every band forms one member sooner (not on top of your tradition's own band).

trade.name: Trade
trade.text: A town that buys what it can't grow.

tiers.text: The southern caravan comes from the start, without waiting for its building, and lays out rarer deals twice as often. Traders leave 5 more shells every round.
